name: prism-objstore
description: Prism Objstore is a distributed object storage engine: systematic Reed–Solomon erasure coding with a Cauchy parity matrix over GF(256), rendezvous-hashed placement with per-zone caps, CRC-32 per shard, degraded reads that rebuild data from parity, budgeted background repair, scrubbing for silent bit rot, buckets with versioning and delete markers, ListObjectsV2 with delimiters, multipart uploads with S3-style ETags, byte ranges, a durability model, and an S3-compatible HTTP API.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
